# **Ray's Ores**
A mod that aims to improve gameplay by adding new ores with tools and armors.
# **Ores**
**The mod currently has 3 ores.** (2 in-game 1 new)

1.Copper
   
 ![Copper Armor & Tools.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a836a0bfedfd827846644719620eab443c43f6e_0.webp)
 
2.Emerald
   
   ![Emerald Armor & Tools.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8f389e6dd9ca782d4ecf9d1414f20ffb524c204_0.webp)
   
3.Ruby
   
   ![Ruby Ore Spawning (Mines)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ffdadff3bc9100723c1c6ae3834bcd41e58c199_0.webp)
   ![Ruby Armor & Tools.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a3c4336500ffaa7f9b8eb9ec186dc9e076c4a75_0.webp)
   
   **If you have any suggestions,** join the discord server and put all of your suggestions!
   
   **If you have any bugs to report or glitches.** Join the discord server and report any bug you find! I'll try my best to fix any bug that you guys find.

   **Future Updates:**
   More Ores Update
   Nether Ores Update
